title: OpenPepXL: An Open-Source Tool for Sensitive Identification of Cross-Linked Peptides in XL-MS
reported_findings: The reanalyzed ribosomal fraction dataset was deposited as PXD014520.
The study reports a 5% cross-link spectrum match (CSM) FDR cutoff for these tool results.
Only the target database was supplied to pLink2, which generated its own decoys.

Later benchmark processing collapsed residue pairs, required at least two supporting CSMs, and excluded close intra-peptide or loop links. Those steps are distinct from preserving the deposited PSM table.
result_format_note: The documented filtered cross-linked spectra output omits decoys; it need not contain per-record Q-values.
standardization_scope: Preserve the source PSM table; retain downstream benchmark rules as provenance.
